entries.text: PROVIDE INDIVIDUAL CONDUITS FOR EACH PUMP, FLOAT, AND TRANSDUCER CABLE. / 1 / OVERSIZE CONDUITS AS REQUIRED BETWEEN WET WELL AND HANDHOLE FOR EASY / REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT OF FACTORY PUMP AND INSTRUMENT CABLES. SEAL / ALL CONDUIT ENTRANCES WITH DUCT SEAL AT COMPLETION OF PROJECT.

2 FLOW METER: SIZE PER CIVIL DRAWINGS. MAGNETIC FLOW METER, ENDRESS-HAUSER / PROMAG W400, CLASS I DIV 2, CARBON STEEL FLANGE, 120-240VAC OR 24VAC/DC, / ETHERNET/IP, POLYURETHANE LINER, 316L ELECTRODES, LOCAL DISPLAY ON FLOW / METER (WAS), REMOTE METERS WITH SUBMERSIBLE KITS (VAULT METERS), NEMA 4X, / NPT 1 PROVIDE (2) 316L GROUNDING RINGS FOR EACH FLOW TUBE. / 2.

3 DEWATERING BUILDING WITH DEWATERING PRESS: UNCLASSIFIED PER NFPA 820-2020 / TABLE 6.2.2, ROW 12a WITH TYPE 'C' VENTILATION, CONTINUOUSLY VENTILATED AT 6 / AIR CHANGES PER HOUR AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH NFPA 820-2020 CHAPTER 9. / PROVIDE VENTILATION FANS, GAS SENSORS, LOCAL ALARM LIGHT AND HORN, AND / ACCESSORIES TO MEET NFPA 820 VENILATION AND MONITORING REQUIREMENTS.

4 DEWATERING SKID SHALL BE PROVIDED PRE WIRED AND TESTED BY THE / MANUFACTURER. SKID ASSEMBLY SHALL BE UL OR ETL LABELED IN ACCORDANCE / WITH WASHINGTON STATE L&I REQUIREMENTS. PROVIDE 480V THREE PHASE POWER / FEEDER CONNECTION, AND CAT 6 SIGNAL CABLE FOR SYSTEM MONITORING.
5 ROUTE SOLENOID WIRING TO INFLUENT PUMP STATION PANEL FOR SOLENOID VALVE / CONTROL.

6 PROVIDE DEDICATED 120V GFCI RECEPTACLE AND 4-20 mA FLOW PACE SIGNAL FROM / PLC SYSTEM FOR 4 LOCATIONS: HYPO FEED PUMP, POLYMER FEED PUMP, INFLUENT / SAMPLER, AND EFFLUENT SAMPLER. SAMPLERS PROVIDED BY OWNER FOR / CONTRACTOR INSTALLATION.
7 PROVIDE 120VAC POWER CIRCUIT FROM PANEL LP2 AND CONTROL SIGNALS AS SHOWN / ON PLC I/O DRAWINGS. WIRE EACH VENTILATON FAN TO CONTROL PANEL - TYP 3 IN / TREATMENT BUILDING.

8 ROUTE RACEWAY FROM TREATMENT BUILDING EQUIPMENT TO HANDHOLES, AND TO / ASSOCIATES CONTROL, MCC OR POWER PANEL. QUANTITY AND SIZE AS REQUIRED; / PROVIDE MINIMUM TWO 1" SPARE CONDUITS FROM EACH POWER AND CONTROL / HANDHOLE TO SIDE OF BUILDING AND STUB UP AND CAP FOR FUTURE USE.
9 INSTALL INFLUENT PUMP MOTOR DISCONNECTS ON BUILDING WALL WITHIN SIGHT OF / WET WELL. COORDINATE FINAL LOCATION DURING CONSTRUCTION.
